name: Diagonal chevrons
description: Diagonal bands raking across the frame in three parallax layers, each with a hard leading edge and a trailing gloss. `chevron` folds the bars into a V; at 0 they stay straight diagonals. Speed lines stretched along the same axis sell the motion.

angle.description: Band direction, 0..1 mapped over half a turn. 0.25 is a 45-degree rake.

freq.description: Bands per unit across the frame.

chevron.description: Folds the bars into a V. 0 leaves them straight.
